'''Chapter 1176''' is titled "With Pride".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color Spread]]: A vertical poster recreating the cover of [[Volume 12]] with every member of the [[Straw Hat Pirates]].

==Short Summary==
The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] arrive to extinguish the fires at the [[Owl Library]] and [[Walrus School]], with [[Vegapunk/Lilith|Lilith]] using "ODCs" to freeze them both solid. They proceed to fight against [[Rimoshifu Killingham|Killingham]] to prevent him from destroying the library and school. At [[Elbaph]]'s Western Village, [[Dorry]] and [[Brogy]] slowly regain control over their [[demon]] bodies and decapitate each other, but this process instead turns them back to normal. Realizing this, they join [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]], [[Hajrudin]], and [[Stansen]] in fighting the demonized giants and removing their demon transformations as well.

==Long Summary==
[[Franky]] sees the carnage in the distance and wonders what is going on, just as [[Vegapunk/Lilith|Lilith]] pulls something out of the box containing [[Vegapunk|Dr. Vegapunk's]] clone, saying she is glad she left it here by the school. The things she pulled out are inventions of hers called "Omni-Drain Converters," or "ODC"s for short. Franky and [[Jewelry Bonney|Bonney]] are curious by what Lilith is showing them as she explains that energy is everywhere on [[Elbaph]], and she asks Franky if he has ever considered fueling himself with something other than cola.

At the burning [[Walrus School|school]] and [[Owl Library|library]], [[Usopp]] calls the destruction they are witnessing the end of the world and comments on how huge the transformed [[Loki]] is compared to [[Kaidou]], but he reasons he is on their side since [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] is with him, something [[Nami]] scolds him for. She and [[Jinbe]] move to extinguish the fire and save the buildings, while [[Nico Robin|Robin]] and [[Sanji]] check up on [[Jaguar D. Saul|Saul]], who is still alive despite his injuries. Nami summons forth [[Zeus]] in cloud form, having grown to a huge size due to storing up a ton of rainwater per Nami's instructions, and starts raining to put of the fires. Unfortunately, [[Rimoshifu Killingham|Killingham]] arrives and stops them by having one of his [[Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Kirin|MMAs]] resembling a Lindworm chomp down on Zeus, reminding them that they want the history of the world gone. Just as the Straw Hats despair over their one hope being lost, Lilith sends forth the ODCs, which extracts the fire energy from the burning schools, leaving behind nothing but ice.

Saul and Robin head for the library while Lilith takes the energy she extracted and turns it into a new form of cola called "Super Vega Cola". As she tosses it to Franky, she tells him that he is built very similarly to a [[Pacifista]], which is why she was surprised to learn he powered himself on simple cola, but with this new stuff, he can become even stronger. Zeus calls Nami for help and she says she will save him, but Killingham sees Saul and Robin running to the library and orders his MMA to destroy it, declaring that a new world can only be born if all of its previous history is destroyed. Jinbe jumps into the water and tells Nami he will rescue Zeus, but Killingham sees him and becomes repulsed by him for being a [[Fish-Men|Fish-Man]], stating he is glad to be wearing a mask so he does not breathe the same air as him. Sanji remarks that Killingham's attitude is atypical for a [[World Noble]], and as such, he will never forgive him for not only being ignorant of a former [[Seven Warlords of the Sea|Warlord of the Sea]], but insulting his friend, which leads to him crushing Killingham's head with ''Ifrit Jambe: Concassé'' and destroying his air helmet. As for Franky, consuming the Super Vega Cola indeed gives him a surge in power, and with his help, both he and Jinbe destroy the MMA and free Zeus. 

At Western Village, the giants are doing their best to fend off the [[Demons|demonized]] giants, but are struggling due their regenerative capabilities. [[Dorry]] and [[Brogy]], however, are able to regain some control over themselves, and express their shame over turning their blades against [[Jarul]] and mindlessly insulting him. In order to atone for that, both of them cut each other's heads off, resulting in their deaths. However, immediately as they die, the ground beneath them flips them, turning them back to normal and alive. Seeing this, [[Hajrudin]], [[Stansen]], and [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] realize that the only way to turn the demons back to normal is to inflict fatal wounds onto them that will undo the transformation, and now that Dorry and Brogy are back on their side, the five of them, despite expressing regret verbally, are in fact getting excited at the many ways they can kill the demons.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Franky]], [[Vegapunk/Lilith|Lilith]], and [[Jewelry Bonney|Bonney]] return to the [[Owl Library]] due to the fighting as Lilith unveils the "[[Omni-Drain Converter]]" (ODC) from the box that held [[Vegapunk]]'s [[Cloning|clone]].
*Meanwhile, [[Nami]] attempts to extinguish the fire on the Owl Library via [[Zeus]], but was stopped by [[Rimoshifu Killingham|Killingham]] and his Lindworm [[Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Kirin|MMA]] who devours Zeus in the process.
**At the same time, [[Jaguar D. Saul|Saul]] regains his consciousness and heads towards the library along with [[Nico Robin|Robin]] to try to recover as many books as possible.
*As the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] confront Killingham, Lilith unleashes the ODCs which extracted all the heat from the library and [[Walrus School|school]] fires leaving an ice trail, extinguishing the fire in the process.
**Lilith then extracts the collected [[energy]] in liquid form dubbed "[[Foods/Beverages#Super Vega Cola|Super Vega Cola]]" and gives it to Franky to power himself.
***According to Lilith, the ODC works by converting the energy of "natural disaster".
*As Killingham orders the Lindworm MMA to devour the library, he is struck in the head by [[Sanji]], while the MMA is punched by Franky and [[Jinbe]], resulting in it both being decapitated and freeing Zeus in the process.
*Back at the [[Sun World#Western Village|Western Village]], the [[Demons|demonized]] [[Brogy]] and [[Dorry]] regain their true selves and apologize to [[Jarul]] for mindlessly insulting and wanting to kill him. After that, Brogy and Dorry decapitate each other, much to the shock of everyone present.
**As the crew of the [[Giant Warrior Pirates]] mourns the apparent death of Brogy and Dorry, they are both revived with their bodies restored back to before they were [[Covenant#Demon Covenant|corrupted]] by [[Nerona Imu|Imu]]'s ''Domi Reversi''. This results in the Giant Warriors and [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] realizing that Imu's corruption can be undone by causing fatal damage to one's body.
***Due to this, Zoro and the Giant Warriors are no longer hesitant to fight the demonized [[giants]] and now eager to "kill" them.
